# Activate Sign out from the profile popover without leaving the dashboard

> Prove that selecting Sign out from the profile popover keeps the user on the same dashboard page.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} in the browser and sign in to ORBITAL with {{username}} and {{password}} until the single-page dashboard is visible.

## Step 2

On the loaded ORBITAL dashboard, store the current URL and the currently visible main dashboard view as the baseline for page continuity before Sign out is activated.

## Step 3

In the header-right area, open the avatar containing AP and confirm the profile popover is visible with ABHINAV PANGARIA, Portfolio Manager, Workspace Institutional Demo, Status Active, and the Sign out action.

## Step 4

Activate Sign out from the profile popover.

## Step 5

Assert the browser still shows the same dashboard URL and the same main dashboard view after Sign out is activated.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-146, ac-147, ac-148, ac-149, ac-150, ac-151, ac-154

Confirm state-transition check: same dashboard page remains active after Sign out is activated (equals) — the stated promise: Activating Sign out from the profile popover does not navigate away from the current dashboard page.

# Open the profile popover and review identity details

> Prove that activating the avatar opens the profile popover and shows the signed-in user's name, role, workspace, status, and the full action list.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} in the browser and sign in to ORBITAL with {{username}} and {{password}} until the single-page dashboard is visible.

## Step 2

In the header-right area, open the avatar containing AP to display the profile popover.

## Step 3

Assert the profile popover shows ABHINAV PANGARIA, Portfolio Manager, the Workspace label with Institutional Demo, and the Status label with Active.

## Step 4

Assert the profile action list shows exactly Preferences, Keyboard shortcuts, and Sign out.

## Step 5 — assert @verifies ac-146, ac-147, ac-148, ac-149, ac-150, ac-151

Confirm absolute check: action list shows Preferences, Keyboard shortcuts, and Sign out (equals) — the stated promise: The profile popover offers exactly these actions in the list: Preferences, Keyboard shortcuts, and Sign out.
